module_summary: Simple dual-clock RAM: independent write port (wclk, enable, address) writes a DEPTHxWIDTH array; read port registers addressed data on rclk.

anchors.name: RAM_MEM
anchors.why: DEPTH x WIDTH memory array written at waddr, read at raddr

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: Registered read data captured from RAM_MEM on rclk when renc

anchors.name: waddr
anchors.why: Write address selecting the RAM_MEM entry

anchors.name: raddr
anchors.why: Read address selecting RAM_MEM entry for rdata

anchors.name: renc
anchors.why: Read enable gating rdata register update

groups.name: ram_array
groups.description: Two-port memory with separate write and registered read ports
